era: Sixth- and seventh-generation open-world military action
summary: Pandemic Studios' open-world military action series focused on contracts, factions, and large-scale destruction.

entries.title: Mercenaries: Playground of Destruction
entries.definitive_edition: Original Xbox version via hardware or backward compatibility

emulation.emulator: xemu or PCSX2 where legal and stable
emulation.notes: Xbox backward compatibility is the cleanest modern route if owned; emulation is a preservation fallback.

primary.version: Original Xbox version / Xbox backward compatibility where owned
primary.why: Mercenaries: Playground of Destruction released for PlayStation 2 and Xbox, and the Xbox version is also playable through Xbox backward compatibility. Xbox is the practical primary route for fidelity and modern access.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Xbox version on original hardware or through Xbox backward compatibility where owned; use PS2 as an alternate original-console route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No PC port or modern remaster is documented in the cited public source; planned sequels after Mercenaries 2 were cancelled.

entries.title: Mercenaries 2: World in Flames

emulation.notes: Use Windows if legally owned; emulate PS3/Xbox 360 only for preservation.

primary.why: Mercenaries 2 released on Windows, PlayStation 2, PlayStation 3, and Xbox 360. Windows is the highest-fidelity route, while the PS2 version is documented as a much weaker version with no content advantage.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version natively where legally owned; use PS3/Xbox 360 if PC access is unavailable and avoid the PS2 route unless preserving that version specifically.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster is documented in the cited public source; later Mercenaries sequels were cancelled.
